description: Continuous crisis pressure overwhelms foresight and locks institutions into short-term response.
AI produces fluent future narratives that hide weak evidence or biased assumptions.
Foresight language and workshops proliferate without changing institutional decisions.
Global risks outpace coordination across climate finance migration health and technology systems.
Indicators and dashboards create apparent foresight while interpretation and decision rules are weak.
Participation exists but has little effect on strategy authority or resource allocation.
Actors invested in existing power resist future-generation justice and participatory foresight.
Foresight systems weaken over time without leadership budget and accountability support.
